name: Battle Pets TD (BETA)
desc:
Welcome to Battle Pets TD - an exciting pet collection tower defense game on Roblox!

NEW Event - Lost Islands are HERE!

🔥 Step into the world of Battle Pets TD and summon your unique creatures!
📦 Collect powerful pets and summon them in battle to defend against enemy waves!
🏆 Conquer challenging Islands or try your hand in endless mode!
😴Let your pets do the work for you when you are AFK, searching the AFK zones for more rewards and pets!


Supports mobile, pc and tablet & console.
Made by Spectral Studios
